title: Advisory-lock helper is elicited off by default; when enabled it wraps pg_advisory_lock or pg_advisory_xact_lock per the elicited scope
asA: developer building a workflow that needs cross-process coordination on a shared Postgres
iWant: an optional advisory-lock helper on the facade that acquires and releases a session-level or transaction-level lock per an elicited key
soThat: cross-process ordering is expressible through the engine's own primitive without a bespoke locks table

acceptanceCriteria.description: The elicited advisoryLockHelper parameter has one of three values (off, session, transaction) with default off; when off the facade does not expose the helper on its public surface. When session or transaction, the facade exposes a withAdvisoryLock(key, callback) verb that acquires pg_advisory_lock (session) or pg_advisory_xact_lock (transaction) with the integer key, runs the callback, and releases the lock via pg_advisory_unlock on the session-level shape; the transaction-level shape releases automatically at COMMIT or ROLLBACK per the Postgres explicit-locking reference.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the facade's public surface after apply, with the advisoryLockHelper elicit answered on each of the three permitted values
acceptanceCriteria.when: the surface is inspected and the helper is invoked with a valid integer key on a supported answer
acceptanceCriteria.then: the surface exposes withAdvisoryLock only when the answer is session or transaction; the helper acquires the correct lock verb per the answer, runs the callback, and releases (session) or lets COMMIT release (transaction); the sidecar records the elicited answer for later validation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Off default: helper genuinely absent. Given the elicited advisory-lock-helper answer off, when the facade opens, then no advisory-lock helper is exposed on the facade's public surface (a call site that attempts to reach for it fails at the module surface, not at a lock acquisition); a source-tree grep finds no pg_advisory_lock or pg_advisory_xact_lock call outside a helper module gated by the elicited enabled value.
acceptanceCriteria.then: no advisory-lock helper appears on the facade surface; grep finds no pg_advisory_lock outside a gated helper
